correctness.rationale: Independently reconstructed the exact 12x16 real Hermitian sampling map, verified its rank is 11, and checked five kernel generators. The four 3x3 principal minors plus determinant yield an exhaustive algebraic 14-real-ray rank-two classification, with exact strict-sign exclusions. All 14 representatives have rank two and their 91 range projector pairs differ; the eigenvector construction proves ambiguities dense inside the planes and outside no ambiguity exists. The exact certificate reran successfully; finite computations alone are not misused as infinite completeness.

originality.rationale: The complete accessible primary preprint arXiv:2205.08753v1 provides universal uniqueness at seven sites (Proposition 3.2), a separate odd-dimensional undersampling counterexample (Proposition 3.4), and an explicit generic recovery question (Question 3.5). Its statements neither imply generic injectivity nor classify the fourteen rank-two Hermitian ambiguity planes at six sites for four coefficients. Directly targeted published-research-index and broad scholarly queries found no dominating or equivalent full six-sample cubic classification. The residual risk is unindexed equivalent coding or Hermitian phase-retrieval literature; a negative search is not itself a proof of priority.
residual_risks: Older unindexed or differently formulated equivalent cubic Hermitian-kernel classification may exist.
